description: Contract read on Arc: one view call on any contract, decoded, with block and time (owner, paused, allowance, balance...). Only view/pure functions; a revert or non-contract is refused before payment. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

fn.description: function signature, e.g. function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_contract_read
